description: Enforcement. Set the policy file to mode=block so core fails when summed intersection time exceeds baseline by more than the threshold (provisionally +15% AND +60 s; final value max(2 x measured p99 spread, 10%) with a floor of 60 s), the same rule per medium shard, or when the new-test allowance is exceeded. The only escape hatch is updating the baseline in the PR with the refresh script and stating the reason in the PR body; no label or comment bypass.
